# v1.0.3 — deterministic release preparation

This patch release leaves the supported v1 CLI, JSON envelope, Pi tools, and
direct Registry unchanged.

It includes `b113cf9`, which removes retired pre-v1 providers, Config keys, and
inactive runtime cache. Direct imports of removed modules fail normally.
Unknown keys already in `config.json` stay on disk and are ignored.

It also includes `ae08694`, an offline retrieval evaluation foundation for
maintainers. That work is not a new CLI or Pi operation.

The `refactor!` / `BREAKING CHANGE` marker on `b113cf9` records removal of
already-retired non-public surfaces, not a supported-contract break. This is
therefore `1.0.3`, not `2.0.0`.

The root npm wrapper, Pi package, and Python metadata are synchronized at
`1.0.3`. This candidate is validated offline; no live-provider validation is
part of release checks.
